newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close higher in continuous rally.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close higher in continuous rally.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed higher for a fifth straight session amid buying pressure from the retail investors, brokers said.
The benchmark index of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) ended 23.36 points or 1.21 percent up at 1,945.73 on a turnover of 101.3 million taka. Of 97 traded issues 70 gained and 23 lost.

"The market is now stabilising after a long bearish spell. The retail investors are coming up with fresh commitments," said one broker. Leasing company IDLC gained 433 taka to 5,132, Singer Bangladesh rose 123 to 12,924 and Beximco Pharmaceuticals was up 6 to 194.
